note: Public maintainer toolkit: registry, template, scaffolder, and public-project report. Public Devin tools are listed below; the maintainer's private runtime remains kind=system and is excluded from public-project reports. Unrelated personal repositories are not part of this catalog. CI is inline per public project; see README.md.

ci.previous_architecture: reusable workflows in the private devin-ci/devin-powerups hub
ci.reason: Reusable workflows living in a private repo are not reliably accessible from public repos, so each project ships a self-contained ci.yml.
ci.shape: test job (pytest for Python repos, node --test for devin-bridge) on windows-latest + ubuntu-latest, plus a secrets-scan job over the repository tree excluding .git, fixtures/ and node_modules/; test source is scanned.

known_issues: PyPI publishing is partial; unlisted packages install from pinned GitHub sources until released.
devin-office is a source-only service, not yet a distributable CLI; macOS support is planned, not claimed.

devin-office.manual_note: Source-only dashboard service; no distributable package metadata yet.

security.label: Security
security.description: Reduce risk around secrets, policy-gated actions, and noisy sessions.

memory.label: Memory
memory.description: Search, connect, and preserve agent knowledge with optional ACP integrations.

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: Convenience alias for the memory and decision tools.

repositories.name: devin-powerups

corporate_windows.reason: local generators work offline; GitHub-backed maintainer reports require explicit credentials

repositories.description: Public maintainer hub: registry, roadmap, project template, scaffolder, release checks, and community catalog generators.

repositories.name: devin-devkit
repositories.note: uv workspace monorepo since F4.5: packages/devkit (this entry) + packages/skill-catalog (absorbed from devin-skill-catalog, which was archived). Package names and CLIs unchanged.
repositories.description: Build on the ecosystem: profile-based installer for the public Devin tools across Linux, Personal Windows and Corporate Windows (isolated uv environments, npm bridge), plus lifecycle and quality gates for .devin skills/rules via devin-skill-catalog.

repositories.name: devin-internals-spec
repositories.description: Documented internals of Devin Desktop/CLI stores + schema-version detection + fixtures + devin-inspect CLI.

repositories.name: devin-state
repositories.description: Devin state lifecycle monorepo: secret/PII redaction (devin-redact), store snapshot backup/restore (devin-backup) and session janitor (devin-janitor), sharing the devin-install-scheduler package.
repositories.note: uv workspace monorepo since F4.1: packages/redact (this entry, ex devin-redact), packages/backup, packages/janitor, shared/install-scheduler. Package-specific tags <pkg>-v* publish each package independently.

repositories.name: devin-history
repositories.description: Export and audit Devin session history — markdown notes, JSON, CSV, Obsidian-ready.
repositories.note: Absorbed into the devin-explore monorepo (F4.3); the devin-history PyPI package and CLI are unchanged, released from packages/history. Original repo archived with MOVED banner.

repositories.name: devin-explore
repositories.description: Understand Devin sessions: diagnose the local installation (stores, schema, locks, config, disk — with fix suggestions), export and audit session history, run FTS5 full-text search, query a knowledge graph of sessions/projects/files/tools, and roll sessions into per-repo milestones and status reports. All local, no telemetry.
repositories.note: uv workspace monorepo since F4.3: packages/doctor (this entry, ex devin-doctor), packages/history, packages/search, packages/graph, packages/pm. Package-specific tags: <pkg>-v*.

repositories.name: devin-pm
repositories.description: Project manager over sessions: per-repo rollups, milestones, status reports, registry.json.
repositories.note: Absorbed into the devin-explore monorepo (F4.3); the devin-pm PyPI package and CLI are unchanged, released from packages/pm. Track moved related->observe on absorption, as pre-announced. Original repo archived with MOVED banner.

repositories.name: devin-assure
repositories.description: Verification monorepo: session-claim audit (devin-qa-pack), deterministic eval harness with dream corpus generator (devin-evals), and local session observability (devin-metrics).
repositories.note: uv workspace monorepo since F4.2: packages/qa-pack (this entry, ex devin-qa-pack), packages/evals, packages/metrics. Package-specific tags: <pkg>-v*.

repositories.name: devin-metrics
repositories.description: Local-only session observability: activity, context size, and token peaks per project/model/day; zero telemetry. Devin does not persist cost fields, so cost is not claimed. Includes an optional dashboard subpackage and command.
repositories.note: Absorbed into the devin-assure monorepo (F4.2); the devin-metrics PyPI package and CLIs (devin-metrics, devin-dashboard) are unchanged, released from packages/metrics. Original repo archived with MOVED banner.

repositories.name: devin-backup
repositories.description: Safe snapshot/verify/restore/rotate of Devin stores with schema-version manifests.
repositories.note: Absorbed into the devin-state monorepo (F4.1); the devin-backup PyPI package and CLI are unchanged, released from packages/backup. Original repo archived with MOVED banner.

repositories.name: devin-search
repositories.description: FTS5 full-text search across all Devin sessions, role-tagged and project-filtered.
repositories.note: Absorbed into the devin-explore monorepo (F4.3); the devin-search PyPI package and CLI are unchanged, released from packages/search. Original repo archived with MOVED banner.

repositories.name: devin-graph
repositories.description: Knowledge graph: sessions, projects, files touched, tools used — queryable edges.
repositories.note: Absorbed into the devin-explore monorepo (F4.3); the devin-graph PyPI package and CLI are unchanged, released from packages/graph. Original repo archived with MOVED banner.

repositories.name: devin-evals
repositories.overlap_note: Complements official Devin Dreaming with deterministic, seed-controlled synthetic sessions carrying known defects (D01-D10) for reproducibility and agent assurance evaluation.
repositories.description: Deterministic eval harness: replay recorded sessions against rubric graders; the `dream` subgroup generates synthetic sessions with known verdicts (D01-D10, absorbs devin-dream).
repositories.note: Absorbed into the devin-assure monorepo (F4.2); the devin-evals PyPI package and CLI are unchanged, released from packages/evals. Original repo archived with MOVED banner.

repositories.name: devin-brain
repositories.overlap_note: Complements official Devin Memory with local evidence provenance and quarantine.
repositories.description: Anti-poisoning memory store: provenance, versioning, quarantine gate, and session-learning utilities.

repositories.name: devin-janitor
repositories.description: Session lifecycle janitor: export-then-delete pipeline, tiered classification, pluggable judge, pending-retry for locked stores.
repositories.note: Absorbed into the devin-state monorepo (F4.1); the devin-janitor PyPI package and CLI are unchanged, released from packages/janitor. Original repo archived with MOVED banner.

repositories.name: devin-control
repositories.description: Control how Devin runs: a policy-gated ACP bridge (Node.js, isolated sessions per repo with allow/deny/ask rules), a deterministic background-worker fan-out planner (devin-fanout), config profile switching with snapshot and rollback, and a live activity board (office, source-only).
repositories.note: uv+npm workspace monorepo since F4.4: packages/bridge (this entry, ex devin-bridge repo; npm package @icaro0310/devin-bridge unchanged), packages/orchestrator, packages/switch, packages/office (source-only). Package-specific tags: <pkg>-v*.

repositories.name: devin-orchestrator
repositories.description: Background-worker fan-out policy: deterministic planner enforcing worker caps (max 3), no nesting, read-only profiles for review, collect-before-report. Skill + always-on rule.
repositories.note: PyPI distribution is devin-fanout because devin-orchestrator is occupied; console command remains devin-orchestrator. Absorbed devin-subagent-orchestrator draft (never published). Absorbed into the devin-control monorepo (F4.3-F4.4), released from packages/orchestrator. Original repo archived with MOVED banner.

repositories.name: personal-agent-system
repositories.description: Private maintainer runtime for personal workflows; excluded from public project reports (kind=system).

repositories.name: devin-dashboard
repositories.description: Private environment-monitoring deployment for the maintainer; not a public user tool.

repositories.name: devin-office
repositories.description: Local-first Devin session and subagent dashboard with standalone and optional split modes.
repositories.note: Absorbed into the devin-control monorepo (F4.4); stays source-only at packages/office (mode mixed). Original repo archived with MOVED banner.

repositories.name: qwenpaw-suite

corporate_windows.reason: requires an optional self-hosted model runtime outside the corporate local-only guarantee

repositories.description: Optional QwenPaw add-on for self-hosted model operators. Includes the local-model bridge, health checks, and GitHub/local documentation sync.

repositories.name: devin-judge
repositories.description: Djævin: calibrated local-first decision layer with typed questions and honest confidence. The Devin ACP backend reuses the model your Devin CLI already runs (no extra download, no API key); the local NLI backend stays as a fully-offline fallback.

repositories.name: awesome-devin
repositories.description: Curated awesome-list of Devin tooling and resources (CC0).

repositories.name: devin-switch
repositories.description: Switch between Devin configuration profiles (hooks, MCP, models) with snapshot, sha256 verify, atomic write, journal and rollback. Dry-run by default; secrets never printed.
repositories.note: Absorbed into the devin-control monorepo (F4.4); the devin-switch PyPI package and CLI are unchanged, released from packages/switch. Original repo archived with MOVED banner.

repositories.name: devin-skill-catalog
repositories.overlap_note: Complements official Devin Skills with local inventory, lint, quarantine and promotion gates for skills and rules. It does not define or run skills.
repositories.note: Absorbed into the devin-devkit monorepo (F4.5); the devin-skill-catalog PyPI package and CLI are unchanged, released from packages/skill-catalog. Original repo archived with MOVED banner.
repositories.description: Lifecycle + quality gates for .devin skills/rules: scan, lint, diff, G1/G2 gates, quarantined→approved→active lifecycle, sha256-verified export/import bundles (imports land quarantined).

repositories.name: devin-learning
repositories.description: Learning-loop runtime (SessionEnd hooks → .devin/skills/learned-*, hook-fires.jsonl). Absorbed into devin-powerups — never had its own repo; entry exists so devin-pm verify reconciles session history.

developers.why: Install a profile and get working CLIs fast
Understand the stores before reading or writing them
Registry, scaffolder and conventions for extending the ecosystem

operations.why: Check store health first — schema, locks, disk
Snapshot before any destructive or cleanup operation
Run lifecycle cleanup only with a verified fresh snapshot
Watch activity and context growth over time

qa.why: Audit what a session actually delivered vs claimed
Replay sessions against rubric graders to lock the behavior
Get calibrated yes/no judgments when the verdict is fuzzy

ai-engineers.why: Drive ACP sessions programmatically with a permission policy
Fan out workers deterministically inside the policy caps
Persist memory with provenance and quarantine gates

devops.why: Own the store lifecycle — snapshot, redact, clean up
Constrain execution and drive sessions under policy
Install the environment profile on each machine

data-scientists.why: Persist session memory with provenance and quarantine
Explore session history, search and graphs
Measure activity and context growth over time
